privacy.title: Privacy Policy

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: This policy explains how the Watheq beta service collects, uses, shares, stores, and protects personal data under applicable Saudi data-protection requirements. It also explains the choices and rights available to you.

items.name: Full name
items.resume: Resume, job description, work history, AI inputs and outputs, and optional contact details

items.device: Device, security, diagnostic, and consent records

items.improvement: To secure, diagnose, support, and improve the service; optional product analytics run only when you allow analytics
items.communication: To communicate with you about your account

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content: Depending on the activity, processing is based on your consent where required, your request to provide the service, compliance with legal obligations, or a legitimate interest permitted by applicable law and balanced against your rights. You may decline optional analytics without losing core service access.

access.title: Right to Access
access.description: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you.

rectification.title: Right to Rectification
rectification.description: Request correction of inaccurate personal data.

deletion.title: Right to Deletion
deletion.description: Request deletion of your personal data.

portability.title: Right to Portability
portability.description: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.

withdraw.title: Right to Withdraw Consent
withdraw.description: Withdraw your consent at any time without affecting prior processing.

complaint.title: Right to Complain
complaint.description: Lodge a complaint with SDAIA if you believe your rights have been violated.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: Resume and job data saved in your browser remains until you clear it or use the deletion controls. Account records are kept while the account is active and are deleted from active application tables when account deletion completes, except limited records that must be retained for security or legal obligations. Infrastructure backups and provider logs may expire on separate controlled schedules.

crossBorder.title: Cross-Border Data Transfers
crossBorder.content: Watheq uses cloud and AI providers whose systems may process data outside Saudi Arabia. International transfers will be limited to what is necessary and handled using the safeguards and assessments required by applicable Saudi law. Do not submit information you are not authorized to share.

providers.title: Service Providers and Sharing
providers.content: Data may be processed by Supabase for accounts and application data; Netlify for hosting and server functions; OpenRouter and Google for requested AI analysis; Sentry for security and error diagnostics with data scrubbing; Mixpanel for optional consent-based analytics; and Resend for service emails. We do not sell personal data. Each provider receives only the data needed for its function, subject to its contract and retention controls.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: For privacy questions or to exercise a data right, contact our privacy team:

privacy.sdaiaReference: This policy is intended to describe current beta behavior under applicable Saudi data-protection requirements. It is not a substitute for your statutory rights. For official guidance, consult the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA).
